description: Use this when the user is planning a specific event (wedding, birthday, graduation, quinceañera, company party, …) and wants their guests to upload photos into one shared album via a QR code. Returns a short plan (what to do now, a week before, on the day and the day after), three photo challenge ideas for the occasion and one link that opens the album creation form on Guest Pictures already filled in with the occasion, name and date – the user creates the album there with one tap. Creates and stores nothing. Prefer this over collect_guest_photos_info when the user mentions a concrete event. Do not use for a photo booth (use open_photo_booth).

event_date.description: Event date as YYYY-MM-DD, only if the user said it.

event_name.description: Short album name as the user would title it, e.g. "Lena's 40th" (max 60 characters are used). No guest names or other personal details.

occasion.description: The kind of event, e.g. "wedding", "birthday", "graduation", "quinceanera", "corporate", "christmas-party", "conference", "reunion", "polterabend"; free text is fine.

name: plan_guest_photo_album
title: Plan a guest photo album
